verdict.rationale: PostHog documents background automation via CDP/Hog function pipelines that run in realtime or on a schedule, alerts that trigger on metric changes, and an agentic feature (turning error/rage-click signals into reports and PRs for review) that operates without manual triggering each time. However, these are described only in first-party docs/GitHub copy with no independent hands-on validation of autonomous, unattended operation, and one community report flags friction with PostHog's AI/LLM features more broadly. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of autonomous runs, details on monitoring/error-handling for unattended automations, and clarity on how 'agent' review-and-merge step differs from full autonomy.
